description:
Package: relm
Title: Local Large Language Models as Base-R Objects
Version: 0.5.0
Authors@R: 
    c(person("Alessandro", "Vadala", , "vadale93@gmail.com", role = c("aut", "cre", "cph")),
      person("ggml authors", role = c("ctb", "cph"), comment = "Bundled llama.cpp and ggml (MIT)"),
      person("Authors of the bundled Rust and native dependencies", role = c("ctb", "cph"),
             comment = "Individual authors, copyrights and licenses are listed in AUTHORS, RUST-NOTICES and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES"))
Description: Load and run local large language models (through a vendored,
    patched 'llama.cpp') from R and work with them as plain data frames and
    matrices in base-R idiom. Provides model loading and tokenization (llm(),
    llm_tokens()), text generation (llm_generate()), next-token distributions
    (llm_logits()), embeddings (llm_embed()), and mechanistic
    interpretability tools -- activation tracing (llm_trace()), activation
    steering (llm_steer()), neuron ablation (llm_ablate()), and grouped statistical
    probes (llm_probe()). Vision-language
    models loaded with their projector take image input in generation and
    embeddings. A checksum-verified downloader (llm_download()) fetches pinned
    models.
License: MIT + file LICENSE | Apache License (== 2.0)
Copyright: See inst/AUTHORS, inst/RUST-NOTICES and
        inst/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES for bundled source authorship,
        copyrights and licenses.
URL: https://github.com/Vadale/R-ebirth,
        https://vadale.r-universe.dev/relm
BugReports: https://github.com/Vadale/R-ebirth/issues
Depends: R (>= 4.5.0)
Imports: methods, nanoarrow
Encoding: UTF-8
Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE)
RoxygenNote: 8.0.0
Suggests: testthat (>= 3.0.0), later (>= 1.4.8), promises (>= 1.5.0),
        glmnet, uwot, dbscan, quarto
VignetteBuilder: quarto
Config/testthat/edition: 3
Config/rextendr/version: 0.5.0
SystemRequirements: Cargo (Rust's package manager) >= 1.85.0, rustc >=
        1.85.0, cmake (>= 3.28), xz
NeedsCompilation: yes
Packaged: 2026-10-19 12:01:42 UTC; runneradmin
Author: Alessandro Vadala [aut, cre, cph],
  ggml authors [ctb, cph] (Bundled llama.cpp and ggml (MIT)),
  Authors of the bundled Rust and native dependencies [ctb, cph]
    (Individual authors, copyrights and licenses are listed in AUTHORS,
    RUST-NOTICES and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES)
Maintainer: Alessandro Vadala <vadale93@gmail.com>
